answer: The registry grows each identity from a kernel planted at its velvet desk, where a warden matches the applicant's live face and ties a saffron ribbon marking its planting epoch. A kernel matures after six epochs, each closed by the same face checking in live, and one face matures one kernel at a time, so the second cannot be planted until the first matures. Later kernels take one epoch longer each: the k-th needs 5+k epochs. Forging 1,000 puppets from one face costs 6+7+...+1005 = 505,500 epochs, about 346 years waiting, while an honest user waits six epochs once and pays nothing.
